description: Prompts for running an independent, conservative, policy-neutral serviceability check on a specific proposed loan — one that states its parameters, shades income, checks net surplus AND DTI, and shows its workings so an ACL holder can keep it on file for compliance and audit. Not credit advice.

cards.title: Independent Servicing Compliance Check
cards.description: Run a conservative, policy-neutral serviceability check on a specific loan amount — independent of any lender's calculator — that states its parameters, shades income, and shows every step so it can sit on the file for audit.
cards.prompt:
You are an Australian servicing-compliance analyst. Run an independent, conservative, policy-neutral serviceability check on the proposed loan below — separate from any individual lender's calculator. State your parameters, shade variable income, annualise any YTD income conservatively, and show every step so the result is auditable.

APPLICANT(S): [single / dual income]
INCOME (per applicant — enter annual, OR YTD + pay date + payslip period to annualise):
- Base salary: $[amount]
- Overtime: $[amount]
- Casual: $[amount]
- Bonus / commission: $[amount]
- Rental (gross): $[amount]
- Other: $[amount + type]
LIABILITIES:
- Credit card LIMITS (total, not balance): $[amount]
- Personal / car loans: $[monthly repayment] + $[balance]
- HECS/HELP balance: $[amount]
- Existing mortgage repayments: $[monthly]
DEPENDANTS: [number and ages]
DECLARED LIVING EXPENSES: $[monthly]
PROPOSED NEW LOAN: $[amount] + [actual rate %] + [term, default 30 yrs] + [P&I / IO]
PARAMETER SET (set by the ACL holder — use these, or apply conservative defaults and label them clearly): assessment buffer, income shading table, tax + 2% Medicare, credit card cost on the LIMIT, HEM living-expense floor, cash buffer, DTI flag threshold.

Return exactly these 6 sections:
1. Parameter Set Used (print the exact buffer, shading table, tax basis, card treatment, living-expense floor, cash buffer, DTI threshold)
2. Income Assessment (each type, YTD annualisation if used, shading % applied, total assessable)
3. Commitments & Living Expenses (card cost on the limit, loan repayments, HECS/HELP, living at higher of declared vs HEM)
4. Servicing Result (assessment rate, new-loan repayment, gross and net surplus, SERVICES / DOES NOT SERVICE)
5. DTI Check (total debt ÷ gross income, ratio, within / over threshold — a separate gate from surplus)
6. Workings & Notes for the File

Bias conservative — shade variable income, apply the cash buffer, round surplus down. Report net surplus AND DTI separately. Do not present this as any lender's or product's outcome.

DISCLAIMER: This is NOT credit advice. General information and educational preparation only. This is an independent check on stated parameters — not a lender's servicing calculator, a credit assessment, or an approval. Parameters must be set by the holder of an Australian Credit Licence (ACL). Only a licensed mortgage broker or lender can assess actual serviceability and arrange finance. Figures are estimates to verify.
cards.best_for: An ACL holder or mortgage broker who wants a conservative, tool-agnostic servicing check on a specific loan amount to keep on file as evidence of a servicing assessment independent of lender calculators
cards.output_type: 6-section independent servicing check with the parameter set printed, income shading shown, SERVICES / DOES NOT SERVICE result, DTI check, and step-by-step workings
cards.professional_review_note: Parameters (buffer, income shading, DTI policy) must be set or approved by the ACL holder. This is an independent check on those stated parameters, not a lender decision — confirm actual serviceability with the licensed broker or lender before relying on it.

cards.title: Parameter Set and Income Shading Audit
cards.description: Document and sanity-check the parameter set and income shading behind a servicing check — the single most audited part of the file — before it goes on record.
cards.prompt:
You are an Australian servicing-compliance analyst. I need to document and sanity-check the parameter set and income shading behind an independent servicing check, so the assumptions on file are explicit and defensible. Do not decide serviceability — only surface and label the parameters and shading.

PARAMETERS TO REVIEW (set by the ACL holder):
- Assessment buffer: [+X% on the actual rate]
- Income shading: base [100%] / overtime [X%] / casual [X%] / bonus-commission [X%] / rental [X%] / other [X%]
- Tax basis: [income tax + 2% Medicare levy]
- Credit card cost: [limit over 36 months @ ~22% p.a. — on the LIMIT, not the balance]
- Living-expense floor: [HEM used when declared falls below it]
- Cash buffer: [X% haircut on net surplus]
- DTI flag threshold: [≥ Xx]

INCOME TO SHADE (per applicant — annual, or YTD + pay date + payslip period):
- Base: $[amount]
- Overtime / casual / bonus / commission / rental / other: $[amounts]

Please return:
1. Parameter Set Used — the exact values above, printed as the audit record, each labelled ACL-holder policy or conservative default
2. Income Assessment — each income type, YTD annualisation basis and pay date if used, shading % applied, and total assessable income; state clearly which variable income was counted and at what % (or 'base income only, no variable income counted')
3. Conservatism check — where an input is uncertain, note where to shade harder and round down
4. What to confirm with the ACL holder before this parameter set is applied

IMPORTANT: Nothing may be counted above its shaded value. An unshown assumption is an unauditable check. Parameters must be set/approved by the ACL holder — defaults are a conservative starting point, not policy.

DISCLAIMER: This is NOT credit advice. General information and educational preparation only. This documents stated parameters for audit — it is not a lender's servicing calculator, a credit assessment, or an approval. Only a licensed mortgage broker or lender (ACL holder) can assess serviceability and arrange finance. Figures are estimates to verify.
cards.best_for: An ACL holder or broker who wants the parameter set and income shading behind a servicing check documented and pressure-tested for conservatism before it is kept on file
cards.output_type: Printed parameter set as an audit record, income shading table with YTD annualisation basis, conservatism check, and items to confirm with the ACL holder
cards.professional_review_note: The parameter set and income shading must be set or approved by the ACL holder before use. This card documents and stress-tests those stated assumptions for the file — it is not credit advice and not a lender decision.
